svg:
Supersonic source, Mach cone, shock wave
source v_s > v
<line x1="500" y1="200" x2="100" y2="80" stroke="#c0392b" stroke-width:1.5"/> <line x1="500" y1="200" x2="100" y2="320" stroke="#c0392b" stroke-width:1.5"/> Mach cone: envelope of wavefronts Outside cone: no sound heard before arrival sin α = v / v_s = 1 / M, M = v_s / v = Mach number α = half-angle of cone with respect to direction of motion. At M=1, α=90° (plane wave) Shock wave: pressure discontinuity at cone surface, energy concentrated. Valid: steady supersonic, point source, homogeneous medium
